verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway and management platform, so AI-generated endpoint tests are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents no capability to generate test cases or assertions from a spec or from responses. The nearest features are MCP-tool autogeneration from REST APIs and Dev Portal 'try API operations', which are different capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI generate test cases or assertions for an endpoint from its spec or responses
